name: Dating Sims: The Visual Novel
source:
[b]Dating Sims[/b] is a parody visual novel that brings choice-based romance to the familiar world of [i]The Sims 4[/i]. Cara Maine has just moved to the small and cozy town of Willow Creek, where she's anxious to branch out on her own for the first time. With the help of her bosses, her friends, and the player, she might just start something amazing.

[From [url=https://oxidentalgames.itch.io/dating-sims-the-visual-novel]Itch.io[/url]]
